address: via di Porta Pinciana 14, Rome, 00187, Italy
bio: The view of Rome from this restaurant situated on the penultimate floor of the Hotel Splendide Royal has few equals, especially at sunset, extending from Villa Medici to Trinità dei Monti, and St Peter’s to the Gianicolo – the only way to enjoy a better view is to head up a floor to the hotel’s Adèle lounge bar for an aperitif or after-dinner drink! This long-established fine-dining restaurant serves modern yet classically-inspired meat and fish dishes....
